periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled downwards and outwards from the medial to the lateral regions relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid, with the vertical dimension significantly exceeding the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward expansion of the black pigment below the ocular center, creating a heavy-bottomed teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile along the posterior boundary where the black band meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending from the base of the neck to approximately one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation across the top of the cranium, approximately twice the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, convex curvature with rounded tops.

other_distinctive_markers: Ventral fur displays significant brownish-pink staining, likely due to environmental contact or moisture, distinct from the primary white-black pelage.
